crop_profile.name: Wheat
organic_fertilizers: Sunn hemp green manuring prior to sowing

hazard_warnings.heat_risk: Terminal heat stress during grain filling reduces plumpness
hazard_warnings.moisture_risk: Susceptibility to root rot during heavy winter rains
hazard_warnings.pest_alert: Yellow Rust (Puccinia striiformis) during high humidity

crop_profile.market_notes: High demand in NCR region; supported by Minimum Support Price (MSP)
crop_profile.llm_reasoning: Coordinates correspond to the Indo-Gangetic Plain where wheat requires cool temperatures for vernalization and is highly sensitive to terminal heat above 32°C. Soil moisture thresholds are calibrated for alluvial loams to prevent waterlogging while maintaining turgor during the critical booting stage.

rotation_history.soil_legacy: Puddled anaerobic soil created subsoil compaction; depleted Nitrogen to 29 mg/kg; high water extraction
Leguminous pulse fixed biological Nitrogen (~30 kg N/ha); low water consumption
